summary_en: HHH1 LLC commenced a tender offer for all ordinary shares and warrants of circlace Inc. (TSE Growth: 5029), excluding treasury shares held by the company. The offeror, backed by funds managed by Hillhouse Investment Management, aims to acquire 100% of circlace shares and take the company private.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares etc. of circlace Inc. (Security Code: 5029) by HHH1 LLC
translation_en_brief:
HHH1 LLC, a limited liability company established on April 10, 2025, announced the commencement of a tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares and warrants of circlace Inc., a company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market (code 5029), excluding treasury shares held by circlace itself. The offeror is wholly owned by Inspire APAC Holdings Pte. Ltd., which is in turn indirectly owned by funds managed or advised by Hillhouse Investment Management, Ltd. and its related entities.

The tender offer is part of a transaction series designed to make HHH1 LLC the sole shareholder of circlace and to take the company private as a wholly owned subsidiary. The announcement indicates that as of the date of disclosure, Hillhouse, the parent company, and the offeror held no shares or warrants in circlace. The disclosure notes that the offeror has entered into a share acquisition agreement with Pasona Group Inc., which is the largest shareholder and a related company of circlace, as of the announcement date.

Specific details regarding the offer price, number of shares to be acquired, acquisition period, and other terms of the tender offer were not disclosed in the pages provided.
